caption: The drawing depicts a single blue pitcher centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is rendered in a deep blue color and features a textured surface with a raised diamond pattern covering the body. It has a wide, slightly flared mouth with a spout, a curved handle attached at the top and bottom of one side, and a circular base that is slightly wider than the body. The shading on the pitcher ranges from dark blue in the shadowed areas to lighter blue highlights, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. The artist's signature, "JANET RIZA," is typed in small capital letters near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
